## Load packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()
library(rlang)

```

## Load the data

```{r}

dat_age <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

```

## Fit model for Test crosses: all four lines

```{r}

## Filter the data
dat_test_age <- dat_age |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm"))

dat_test_age <- dat_test_age |> dplyr::filter(Cross == "Test cross W- x W+" & !is.na(MaleAge))

table(dat_test_age$Male, dat_test_age$MaleAge)

m_test_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_test_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_test_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + MaleAge + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_test_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

### Convergence and model comparison

m_test_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_test_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_test_age)
logLik(m_test_no_age)
logLik(m_test_age)

anova(m_test_no_age, m_test_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_test_no_age, m_test_age, rank = "AICc")
```

## Fit model for Test crosses: CI-lines only (Bal and Trento)

```{r}
dat_CI_age <- dat_test_age |> dplyr::filter(Male %in% c("Bal", "Trento"))

table(dat_CI_age$Male, dat_CI_age$MaleAge)

m_CI_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_CI_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_CI_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + MaleAge + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_CI_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_CI_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_CI_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_CI_age)
logLik(m_CI_no_age)
logLik(m_CI_age)

anova(m_CI_no_age, m_CI_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_CI_no_age, m_CI_age, rank = "AICc")
```

## Fit model for Test crosses: Bal line only

```{r}
dat_Bal_age <- dat_test_age |> dplyr::filter(Male == "Bal") 

table(dat_Bal_age$MaleAge)

m_Bal_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ 1 + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_Bal_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_Bal_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ MaleAge + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_Bal_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_Bal_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_Bal_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_Bal_age)
logLik(m_Bal_no_age)
logLik(m_Bal_age)

anova(m_Bal_no_age, m_Bal_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_Bal_no_age, m_Bal_age, rank = "AICc")

```

## Control cross 3

```{r}
dat_control3_age <- dat_age |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("BalxBal", "TrentoxTrento",  "RennesxRennes", "Par6xPar6")) 

table(dat_control3_age$Male, dat_control3_age$MaleAge)

m_control3_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_control3_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_control3_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + MaleAge + (1 | CoupleID), data = dat_control3_age, ziformula = ~1, family = binomial, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_control3_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_control3_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_control3_age)
logLik(m_control3_no_age)
logLik(m_control3_age)

anova(m_control3_no_age, m_control3_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_control3_no_age, m_control3_age, rank = "AICc")
```

## Summary of observed hatch rates

```{r}
dat_test_age |> dplyr::group_by(Male, MaleAge) |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), mean_hatchrate = mean(hatchrate, na.rm = TRUE), median_hatchrate = median(hatchrate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

dat_control3_age |> dplyr::group_by(Male, MaleAge) |> dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), mean_hatchrate = mean(hatchrate, na.rm = TRUE), median_hatchrate = median(hatchrate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```
